run_game_tree_traversal: run the game tree traversal example on tic_tac_toe to collect game statistics
traverse_game_tree: traverse a pyspiel game tree recursively collecting node counts and information states
create_game_stats: create a GameStats instance to track terminal, chance, decision, and simultaneous node counts
load_and_analyze_game: load a pyspiel game by name and analyze its full game tree structure
collect_info_state_dict: collect information state strings mapped to their legal actions from a game tree
